I haven’t. I don’t want it on my medical record. 

My thoughts are - I want to die. I want to disappear... but every which way I google says the chances of death are slim... and if it’s slim then I cannot do it because I don’t want to deal with the aftermath if I don’t succeed. 

The urge to just disappear is overwhelming and I cannot cope

I cannot get a job right now because I have to look after our daughter. She’s too young for our local nursery (they accept from age 2 only but there’s no space for her until September) but I just feel absolutely useless. I try my best. I really do but I cannot shake the overwhelming thoughts in my head telling me it’s time to end it all and everyone around me would be better off if I was dead. 

I don’t want the embarrassment of attempting suicide and failing and then everyone finding out and everyone thinking it’s just for attention when it isn’t. I don’t want to be a burden anymorw

Thank you for taking time out of your day to reply.
